reference_intent: Match the perceived production quality of the supplied 1672x941 concept references without baking UI text into artwork.

architecture.principle: high-resolution art plate plus live React interaction layers
architecture.ui_rule: All labels, buttons, objectives, PSI values, risk markers and dialogue remain runtime DOM/UI. Final background art contains no readable interface text.

strategy_map.camera: oblique construction-site overview, approximately 30-40 degree elevation, realistic depth, readable work zones
strategy_map.style: commercial 2.5D construction strategy drama; grounded Korean high-rise construction realism; clean cinematic daylight; adult audience; no toy-like diorama look
must_show: multiple high-rise concrete structures at different completion stages
tower crane with believable mast/jib scale
temporary access road and vehicle circulation
temporary fencing, hoist or lift context, scaffolding or safety netting
enough negative space for PSI panel, objectives, minimap, dialogue and action controls
reject: flat CSS illustration as final art
baked Korean text, buttons, icons or hazard labels

art_safe_zones.central_interaction: 20-82% width, 12-76% height should remain spatially readable

map_anchor_contract.note: Coordinates are normalized interaction targets and may be tuned after final plate review without changing gameplay IDs.

stop_work.art_separation: background + character cutouts + props + live decision UI
stop_work.requirement: PPE, temporary edge protection, suspended-load logic and character gesture must read immediately

office_dialogue.art_separation: site-office background + named character cutouts + live dialogue UI
office_dialogue.requirement: warm/cool mixed light, believable paperwork and field-office wear, role/trade identity preserved

day_result.art_separation: environment plate + player silhouette/cutout + live PSI/result dashboard
day_result.requirement: reflective closure, not heroic propaganda or grading baked into art

production_order: UI spacing and crop QA at desktop, tablet portrait, phone portrait, phone landscape

strategy_map: final WebP resolves instead of foundation-map-rc.svg
zone and signal overlays align to physical site features
named characters remain clickable and visually grounded
no critical UI overlaps focal construction details
desktop presentation reads at reference-tier density without looking like a prototype
cinematic: background is production raster art, not RC SVG
dialogue and choice UI remain live text
scene remains readable without relying on color-coded correct/wrong answers
